title: Vanishing and exploding gradients in recurrent neural networks
description: Training recurrent neural networks is problematic because backpropagated gradients either grow or shrink at each time step, causing them to explode or vanish over many time steps, which hinders learning long sequences.
canonical_description: recurrent neural networks suffer from vanishing and exploding gradients during training

evidence.anchor: gradients either grow or shrink at each time step
evidence.quote: RNNs are very powerful dynamic systems, but training them has proved to be problematic because the backpropagated gradients either grow or shrink at each time step, so over many time steps they typically explode or vanish<sup>77,78</sup>.
